history.summary: A 2017 99-yr leasehold 3BR in Hillview (D23) at $1,634 PSF, slightly below the $1,684 median, backed by a robust 105-txn URA series showing 4.2%/yr appreciation. Solid liquidity and data quality; the $1.9M family quantum sits in a reasonable band, capped only by OCR location and leasehold decay.
history.rating_rationale: Rare combination here of reliable data (105 txns), 4.2%/yr appreciation, on_frontier=true, and a sub-median asking PSF ($1,634 vs $1,684). 3BR at $1.9M near Hillview DTL (810m) appeals to the deep HDB-upgrader family pool. Score_1000 of 580 understates it given the data strength; leasehold + OCR are the limiting factors, not deal-breakers.
red_flags: 99-yr leasehold (2017) — decay vs freehold peers in this batch
OCR/D23 appreciation baseline (~3.7%) lower than RCR
810m to Hillview MRT — acceptable but not doorstep
catalysts: Hillview DTL connectivity and Hillview Rise nearby amenity growth
